fullText.simplified:
师父

    “母亲，母亲……”成香倒在地上，难过地哭了。
    前面走来一位老人，看到成香，关心地问：“孩子，你怎么了？你找不到母亲了吗？”
    成香哭着说：“我母亲被一个坏神仙压在华山下面了，我要找到我母亲，我要救她。”
    老人问：“华山的山路高低不平，登华山比登天还难，你不怕吗？”
    一点力气都没有的成香说：“不管是登华山还是登天，我都不怕！我一定要去救我母亲。
    老人再问：“你母亲是被神仙压在华山下的，你只是个人类，你打得过神仙吗？”
    成香说：“世界上一定有打败神仙的方法，我会想办法打败二龙神的。”
    老人笑了，说：“我有打败神仙的方法，可以教你，你愿意做我的弟子吗？”
    成香激动地看着老人，他突然有了力气，爬起来对老人诚恳地说：“我愿意，师父！请您教我！”
    老人笑着说：“好，从今天开始，你就是我的弟子了。”
    成香跟老人回了家。老人的头发全白了，看上去很大年纪了，但是本领特别好，成香学得非常认真。不管是雨天还是雪天，不管是天冷还是天热，成香每天都跟着老人学习武功，勤奋刻苦的他一刻也不休息。
    成香想：“只要我学好本领，就可以打败二龙神、救出母亲了！”
    成香不想父亲担心，就给父亲写了一封信，把师父的事情告诉了父亲。父亲收到信后，还是很担心成香。他走了一个多月的路，来到了师父家。
    父亲看到成香长高了，有点儿高兴，又有点儿担心。
    师父笑着对父亲说：“孩子长大了，你可以放心了。”
    父亲看着远处正在练功的成香，说：“我知道成香是个好孩子，但还是会担心他走错路、做错事，这就是一个父亲的心吧。”
    师父笑了笑，说：“什么是对，什么是错，又有谁说得清楚呢？有些事情，你认为是对的，但其实它是错的。就像我，以前我觉得我做的所有事情都是对的，但这些年总有人和我说，‘你错了，你的规矩不合理！你做了坏事，快把我的爱人还给我。’”
    父亲张大了嘴，吃惊地看着师父：“您是神仙？您听到我的请求了？”
    师父点头说：“都听到了。刘向，以后不要再说了，我听了八年了，真的不想再听了。”
    父亲的眼睛红了，他问：“惩罚结束了吗？您能把她还给我了吗？”
    师父笑了笑，没有说话，他看着远处勤奋刻苦练功的成香，慢慢地说：“华三有一个好儿子。”说完，他再问父亲：“现在你放心把成香交给我了吗？”
    父亲明白了，他激动得说不出话来，过了很长时间才流着泪，诚恳地说：“谢谢您。”
父亲说完就回家去了，他把成香留给了师父。
fullText.traditional:
師父

    “母親，母親……”成香倒在地上，難過地哭了。
    前面走來一位老人，看到成香，關心地問：“孩子，你怎麼了？你找不到母親了嗎？”
    成香哭著說：“我母親被一個壞神仙壓在華山下面了，我要找到我母親，我要救她。”
    老人問：“華山的山路高低不平，登華山比登天還難，你不怕嗎？”
    一點力氣都沒有的成香說：“不管是登華山還是登天，我都不怕！我一定要去救我母親。
    老人再問：“你母親是被神仙壓在華山下的，你只是個人類，你打得過神仙嗎？”
    成香說：“世界上一定有打敗神仙的方法，我會想辦法打敗二龍神的。”
    老人笑了，說：“我有打敗神仙的方法，可以教你，你願意做我的弟子嗎？”
    成香激動地看著老人，他突然有了力氣，爬起來對老人誠懇地說：“我願意，師父！請您教我！”
    老人笑著說：“好，從今天開始，你就是我的弟子了。”
    成香跟老人回了家。老人的頭髮全白了，看上去很大年紀了，但是本領特別好，成香學得非常認真。不管是雨天還是雪天，不管是天冷還是天熱，成香每天都跟著老人學習武功，勤奮刻苦的他一刻也不休息。
    成香想：“只要我學好本領，就可以打敗二龍神、救出母親了！”
    成香不想父親擔心，就給父親寫了一封信，把師父的事情告訴了父親。父親收到信後，還是很擔心成香。他走了一個多月的路，來到了師父家。
    父親看到成香長高了，有點兒高興，又有點兒擔心。
    師父笑著對父親說：“孩子長大了，你可以放心了。”
    父親看著遠處正在練功的成香，說：“我知道成香是個好孩子，但還是會擔心他走錯路、做錯事，這就是一個父親的心吧。”
    師父笑了笑，說：“什麼是對，什麼是錯，又有誰說得清楚呢？有些事情，你認為是對的，但其實它是錯的。就像我，以前我覺得我做的所有事情都是對的，但這些年總有人和我說，‘你錯了，你的規矩不合理！你做了壞事，快把我的愛人還給我。’”
    父親張大了嘴，吃驚地看著師父：“您是神仙？您聽到我的請求了？”
    師父點頭說：“都聽到了。劉向，以後不要再說了，我聽了八年了，真的不想再聽了。”
    父親的眼睛紅了，他問：“懲罰結束了嗎？您能把她還給我了嗎？”
    師父笑了笑，沒有說話，他看著遠處勤奮刻苦練功的成香，慢慢地說：“華三有一個好兒子。”說完，他再問父親：“現在你放心把成香交給我了嗎？”
    父親明白了，他激動得說不出話來，過了很長時間才流著淚，誠懇地說：“謝謝您。”
父親說完就回家去了，他把成香留給了師父。

sentences.simplified: 父亲张大了嘴，吃惊地看着师父：“您是神仙？您听到我的请求了？”
sentences.traditional: 父親張大了嘴，吃驚地看著師父：“您是神仙？您聽到我的請求了？”
sentences.pinyin: fù qīn zhāng dà le zuǐ chī jīng de kàn zhe shī fu nín shì shén xiān nín tīng dào wǒ de qǐng qiú le
sentences.english: The father’s mouth opened wide, and he looked at the master in shock: “Are you an immortal? Did you hear my request?”

sentences.simplified: 师父点头说：“都听到了。刘向，以后不要再说了，
sentences.traditional: 師父點頭說：“都聽到了。劉向，以後不要再說了，
sentences.pinyin: shī fu diǎn tóu shuō dōu tīng dào le liú xiàng yǐ hòu bú yào zài shuō le
sentences.english: The master nodded and said, “I heard them all. Liu Xiang, you don’t have to say them anymore.

sentences.simplified: 我听了八年了，真的不想再听了。”
sentences.traditional: 我聽了八年了，真的不想再聽了。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tīng le bā nián le zhēn de bù xiǎng zài tīng le
sentences.english: I’ve heard them for eight years. I really don’t want to hear them anymore.”

sentences.simplified: 父亲的眼睛红了，他问：“惩罚结束了吗？您能把她还给我了吗？”
sentences.traditional: 父親的眼睛紅了，他問：“懲罰結束了嗎？您能把她還給我了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: fù qīn de yǎn jing hóng le tā wèn chéng fá jié shù le ma nín néng bǎ tā huán gěi wǒ le ma
sentences.english: The father’s eyes went red, and he asked, “Is the punishment over? Can you give her back to me?”

sentences.simplified: 师父笑了笑，没有说话，
sentences.traditional: 師父笑了笑，沒有說話，
sentences.pinyin: shī fu xiào le xiào méi yǒu shuō huà
sentences.english: The master smiled and stopped talking.

sentences.simplified: 他看着远处勤奋刻苦练功的成香，慢慢地说：“华三有一个好儿子。”
sentences.traditional: 他看著遠處勤奮刻苦練功的成香，慢慢地說：“華三有一個好兒子。”
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn zhe yuǎn chù qín fèn kè kǔ liàn gōng de chéng xiāng màn man de shuō huà sān yǒu yí ge hǎo ér zi
sentences.english: He watched Chengxiang diligently practice martial arts in the distance and said slowly, “Hua San has a good son.”

sentences.simplified: 说完，他再问父亲：“现在你放心把成香交给我了吗？”
sentences.traditional: 說完，他再問父親：“現在你放心把成香交給我了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: shuō wán tā zài wèn fù qīn xiàn zài nǐ fàng xīn bǎ chéng xiāng jiāo gěi wǒ le ma
sentences.english: After saying that, he asked the father, “Do you feel at ease now giving Chengxiang to me?”

sentences.simplified: 父亲明白了，他激动得说不出话来，
sentences.traditional: 父親明白了，他激動得說不出話來，
sentences.pinyin: fù qīn míng bai le tā jī dòng de shuō bù chū huà lái
sentences.english: The father understood and was so excited that he couldn’t say anything more.

sentences.simplified: 过了很长时间才流着泪，诚恳地说：“谢谢您。”
sentences.traditional: 過了很長時間才流著淚，誠懇地說：“謝謝您。”
sentences.pinyin: guò le hěn cháng shí jiān cái liú zhe lèi chéng kěn de shuō xiè xie nín
sentences.english: Only after a long time did his tears flow down, and he said sincerely, “Thank you.”

sentences.simplified: 父亲说完就回家去了，他把成香留给了师父。
sentences.traditional: 父親說完就回家去了，他把成香留給了師父。
sentences.pinyin: fù qīn shuō wán jiù huí jiā qù le tā bǎ chéng xiāng liú gěi le shī fu
sentences.english: After the father finished speaking, he returned home and left Chengxiang with the master.

sentence_translations: The Master
“Mother … mother …” Chengxiang had fallen to the ground and was crying sadly.
An old man walked over. He saw Chengxiang and asked with concern, “Child, what happened? Can’t you find your mother?”
Chengxiang cried and said, “My mother is being held under Mount Hua by an evil immortal.
I have to find my mother. I have to save her.”
The old man said, “The path on Mount Hua is very uneven.
It’s harder to ascend Mount Hua than to ascend to heaven. Aren’t you afraid?
Chengxiang, who had no strength left in him, said, ..
.. “No matter if it’s ascending Mount Hua or ascending to heaven, I’m not afraid at all!
I absolutely have to save my mother.”
The old man asked again, ..
.. “Your mother is being held under Mount Hua by an immortal. You’re just a human. Can you defeat an immortal?”
Chengxiang said, “There must be a way in this world to defeat an immortal. I’ll think of a way to defeat Erlong Shen!”
The old man smiled and said, “I have a way to defeat an immortal. I can teach you. Are you willing to be my disciple?”
Chengxiang excitedly looked at the old man.
He suddenly had more strength. He got up and sincerely said to the old man, “I am willing, master! Please teach me!”
The old man said with a smile, “Okay. Starting today, you are my disciple!”
Chengxiang went home with the old man. The old man had completely white hair and looked very old.
But he had great skills, and Chengxiang studied very earnestly.
No matter if it rained or snowed, no matter if the weather was cold or hot, ..
.. Chengxiang diligently practiced martial arts every day with the old man and didn’t take a moment’s rest.
Chengxiang thought: “I just have to learn this skill, and then I can defeat Erlong Shen and save Mother!”
Chengxiang didn’t want his father to worry, so he wrote his father a letter and told him about his master.
When his father received the letter, he was still very worried about Chengxiang.
He walked for over a month and arrived at the master’s home.
The father saw that Chengxiang had grown tall. He was both a little happy and a little worried.
The master smiled and said to the father, “The child is growing up. You can be at ease.”
The father watched Chengxiang, who was practicing martial arts at a distance, and said, ..
.. “I know that Chengxiang is a good child. But I still worry that he will go the wrong way or do something wrong.
This is the heart of a father.”
The master smiled and said, “Who can clearly say what is right and what is wrong?
In some situations, I believe I’m doing the right thing, but it’s actually wrong.
Like me, I used to think that everything I did was right, but someone kept saying to me, ..
.. ‘You are in the wrong. This rule is unreasonable! You did something bad. Give me my wife back now.’”
The father’s mouth opened wide, and he looked at the master in shock: “Are you an immortal? Did you hear my request?”
The master nodded and said, “I heard them all. Liu Xiang, you don’t have to say them anymore.
I’ve heard them for eight years. I really don’t want to hear them anymore.”
The father’s eyes went red, and he asked, “Is the punishment over? Can you give her back to me?”
The master smiled and stopped talking.
He watched Chengxiang diligently practice martial arts in the distance and said slowly, “Hua San has a good son.”
After saying that, he asked the father, “Do you feel at ease now giving Chengxiang to me?”
The father understood and was so excited that he couldn’t say anything more.
Only after a long time did his tears flow down, and he said sincerely, “Thank you.”
After the father finished speaking, he returned home and left Chengxiang with the master.
